title: After Save, the Make internal window shows for each picked customer in turn
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new organization in which the Internal Work Orders setting has never been switched on.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with one open work order, work order 1, in Estimate.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, with one open work order, work order 2, in Estimate.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Work Orders.
  2. Switch the "Internal Work Orders" toggle on.
  3. Pick customer A in the customer picker.
  4. Pick customer B in the customer picker.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click "Keep billable".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The toggle is off.

Step 2:

  • The "Which customers are your own company?" window opens.

Step 3:

  • Customer A shows as a chip.

Step 4:

  • Customer B shows as a chip.

Step 5:

  • The turn-on window closes.
  • A window opens reading "1 open work orders for [customer A's name] are billable. Make them internal? Prices, fees and discounts are removed; costs and hours are kept."
  • It lists work order 1.

Step 6:

  • A second window opens for customer B, with the same text naming customer B, and lists work order 2.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R2: “Switching the toggle from off to on for the first time in the organization opens the modal "Which customers are your own company?" with the body "Work orders for these customers are internal: no prices and no invoice; parts cost posts to the expense account of their category when you use QuickBooks or AccountingHub. Nothing is picked for you: your location is not always a customer, and the names can differ. Pick one or more, or do it later from the customer page.", a customer picker (the standard customer Select with search, several customers can be picked, each shown as a chip with a remove control; up to 50, with the hint "Pick up to 50 customers here. Flag more from Edit Customer."), the line "You can change this any time: Customers > Edit Customer > Internal customer." and the buttons "Do this later" and "Save". No customer is preselected. Save is disabled until at least one customer is picked. Save saves the toggle (on) and flags the picked customers in one step (only this toggle and the flags; other unsaved changes on the tab wait for Save settings; to back out, the user switches the toggle off and saves settings), closes the modal and then shows the dialog of S1-R11 for each picked customer with open billable work orders, one after another; the page shows the toggle on and the hint lines of S1-R3 with nothing left to save for this setting. Closing the modal with X acts as "Do this later" (S1-R5); Esc and a click outside do nothing, as in every dialog of the app. The modal is shown once per organization: switching the toggle on again later opens nothing (S1-R10). Switching it off opens nothing. The modal never lists who is flagged, and Settings > Work Orders never lists customers.”
  • S1-R11: “When a customer is flagged (Save in the modal, or on Edit Customer with the checkbox ticked), or the setting is turned on again while flagged customers have open billable work orders (S1-R10), a dialog reads "[n] open work orders for [customer] are billable. Make them internal? Prices, fees and discounts are removed; costs and hours are kept." and lists those work orders under the body, one line each (number, location, unit, status), at every location the user has access to, up to 10 rows and then "and [n] more". Counted as open: every billable work order of that customer that is not invoiced, not paid and not Declined, Estimates included. A row with a deposit carries the note "Deposit: stays billable"; a row with a posted vendor bill carries the note "Vendor bill: cost moves at Close" (no dialog of S2-R8 per work order on this path). Buttons: "Keep billable" and "Make internal". Make internal applies S2-R7 to every listed work order without a deposit; those with a deposit stay billable until the deposit is reversed and the dialog is shown again. Keep billable leaves them as they are; they finish with an invoice as today. Open no-charge work orders of that customer are not listed: they stay no charge with their category and keep Change category and Convert to Billable (S2-R6). With no open billable work orders the dialog is not shown. Saving Edit Customer for a customer that carries the flag shows this dialog again whenever that customer has open billable work orders, so work orders left billable earlier (a deposit since reversed, Keep billable, a user without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit') can be made internal later. Open billable work orders at locations the user has no access to are not listed; the line "[n] more at locations you don't have access to." under the list says how many, and they are converted when a user with access saves Edit Customer or the setting is turned on again (S1-R10). Make internal converts the listed work orders without switching location. A pending portal estimate of a work order made internal is no longer available: the portal refuses approval with "This estimate is no longer available." and shows the existing obsolete banner, since internal work orders are never on the portal (S2-R11).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Customer flagged with open billable work orders, or setting turned on again | "[n] open work orders for [customer] are billable. Make them internal? Prices, fees and discounts are removed; costs and hours are kept." plus the list (up to 10 rows, then "and [n] more") | Confirmation dialog, Keep billable / Make internal; OK only without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit'”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
